_note: Single-cell RNA-seq via ORCA (fetch_samplesheet → synstage → scrnaseq → synindex). Sample from Olah et al. 2020 (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-020-19737-2) which used 10x Chromium v2 (16bp barcode + 10bp UMI per Methods). Uses CellRanger aligner with pre-built 10x GRCh38 reference directly. input_samplesheet_id: samplesheet synid. output_folder_id: output folder synid.
